findings.reason: The three explicit profiles and their endpoint traces form the concrete construction that refutes uniqueness. Three separate coordinate plots materially clarify the interior tent corner and the different pairs of endpoint limits; a combined plot would obscure the overlapping portions of the tent and straight profiles. Both original standalone tiles contain only prose and formulas. This is a useful explanatory addition under the authorized diagram criterion, not a claim that the original proof was incomplete.
findings.action: Added one three-panel TikZ illustration and explanatory text in the existing final Remarks.

correction: Added separate plots of x, 1-x, and min{x,1-x} on the open unit interval, with open endpoint rings, explicit endpoint trace pairs, and the tent peak coordinate. No original source bytes were replaced.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Real-valued profiles u_i:(0,1)→R, as in Statement refuted and Facts Given.
diagram_math_checks.check: Each panel uses the same x and u scales: graphical coordinate 2 corresponds to mathematical coordinate 1. The axis labels x=0 and x=1 identify this common scaling. The plotted straight segments represent u_1=x and u_2=1-x, with slopes +1 and -1 respectively.
diagram_math_checks.justification: The explicit formulas in Statement refuted and proof step 2.1 give these affine profiles and slopes.

diagram_math_checks.check: The two graph segments are (0,0)→(1/2,1/2) and (1/2,1/2)→(1,0) in mathematical coordinates. They meet at an included interior corner with slopes +1 then -1. No upward corner or extra branch is drawn.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement refuted gives u_3=1/2-|x-1/2|; proof step 2.1 writes its local formula 1/2-|h| and verifies viscosity testing at the peak. The figure does not claim classical differentiability there.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Six excluded boundary endpoints, with continuous extension traces.
diagram_math_checks.check: Every graph endpoint at x=0 or x=1 is an open ring; the trace labels are (0,1), (1,0), (0,0), ordered left endpoint then right endpoint. No boundary condition is imposed by the picture.
diagram_math_checks.justification: The domain is Ω=(0,1); proof step 3.1 explicitly evaluates all six continuous boundary values. The added prose distinguishes limits from points of the solution domain.

diagram_math_checks.check: The two affine graphs each consist of one nonclosed segment. The tent consists of exactly two segments sharing its interior vertex; none of the three graphs has a closing edge. There are no named-node paths requiring --cycle. The rigorous proof remains unchanged and independent of the figure.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Compiled SVG shows the two tent paths meet at exactly the same point (181.464,-9.88), and no last-to-first segment. The existing steps 1.1–3.1 prove all solution and trace assertions without a diagram.

The tent peak is continuous and its two segments meet exactly.
